title: Luscious Egyptian Fava Pilaf
description: A unique Egyptian dish featuring fava beans, tangy sauce, and crispy onions, all in one delicious pilaf. Perfect for a weekend brunch.

ingredients.name: fava beans
ingredients.amount: 1 1/2 cups dried, soaked overnight and drained

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for another minute.
Add fava beans, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Add lemon juice and stir to combine.
Gradually add soda water while stirring to prevent the mixture from becoming too thick.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes or until the fava beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
